content: Upon the wheel of great bliss, appearing as myself,Amidst the gathering of infinite peaceful and wrathful deities,Upon a lion throne, lotus, moon, and sun disk seat,Resides the root lama, the embodiment of all refuge.OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂThis ocean of tea offerings, the All-Good Great Bliss,I offer to please the venerable root lama.From within the state of spontaneously present, expansive great bliss,Grant your blessings that our minds may merge as one.OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂThis ocean of tea offerings, the All-Good Great Bliss,I offer to please the assembly of lineage-holding gurus.From within the state of spontaneously present, expansive great bliss,Grant your blessings that I may master the stainless path of liberation.OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂThis ocean of tea offerings, the All-Good Great Bliss,I offer to please the assembly of deities of the yidam mandala.From within the state of spontaneously present, expansive great bliss,Please bestow the supreme and common accomplishments.OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂThis ocean of tea offerings, the All-Good Great Bliss,I offer to please the assembly of the Precious Jewels.From within the state of spontaneously present, expansive great bliss,Please deliver us from the terrors of existence and peace.OṂ ĀḤ HŪṂThis ocean of tea offerings, the All-Good Great Bliss,I offer to please the assembly of ḍākinīs and Dharma protectors.From within the state of spontaneously present, expansive great bliss,Please accomplish all the activities of the yogi without exception.To you, the root gurus of great bliss,I offer this tea offering of the All-Good Great Bliss;Through the vajra of immutable, unified great bliss,May you guide wandering beings through your emanations.Maṅgalam.
